profile.subtitleJa: ヨシヤのために哀悼した人物として名が挙がります。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌下35:25は、ヨシヤの死を悼んだエレミヤと、哀歌を歌った男女について記します。

facts.textJa: 本文はエレミヤを預言者と呼び、王が彼を通して語られた主の言葉にへりくだらなかったと記します。
歴代誌下36章は、主の言葉がエレミヤを通して語られたことに触れます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Jeremiah lamented for Josiah, and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Josiah in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel. Behold, they are written in the lamentations.
He did that which was evil in the LORD his God’s sight. He didn’t humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the LORD’s mouth.
to fulfill the LORD’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths. As long as it lay desolate, it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
